title.en: Tencent launches hosted Hy4 access while full weights remain pending
title.zhHans: 腾讯推出 Hy4 托管访问，完整权重仍待发布

searchSummary.en: Tencent announced hosted Hy4 availability on November 4, and OpenRouter listed a provider; full model weights were still planned.
searchSummary.zhHans: 腾讯于 11 月 4 日宣布 Hy4 可通过托管服务使用，OpenRouter 列出提供方；完整模型权重当时仍是发布计划。

summary.en: Tencent announced Hy4 access on November 4 via TokenHub and other products, while OpenRouter listed a hosted Hy4 provider. Tencent said it planned to publish the new model weights and system card in the coming days. The older public Hy4-preview repository was created in August and does not establish that the newly announced full Hy4 weights had been released. No independent performance gain is established here.
summary.zhHans: 腾讯于 11 月 4 日宣布，可通过 TokenHub 等产品使用 Hy4；OpenRouter 也列出了托管 Hy4 的提供方。腾讯称计划在未来数日发布新模型权重和系统卡。公开的旧 Hy4-preview 仓库创建于 8 月，不能证明此次发布的正式版 Hy4 权重已经开放。本轮也未独立证实性能提升。

narrative.en: The new stage is hosted access to the full Hy4 release, not the older preview repository or a completed open-weight release. OpenRouter independently documents distribution, but its model description may reflect Tencent marketing and is not a benchmark replication.
narrative.zhHans: 新阶段是正式版 Hy4 的托管访问，不是旧预览版仓库，也不是完整权重已经开放。OpenRouter 独立记录了分发渠道，但其模型描述可能沿用腾讯宣传，不能当作独立跑分复现。

text.en: Tencent announced hosted Hy4 access on November 4; OpenRouter separately listed a hosted provider.
text.zhHans: 腾讯于 11 月 4 日宣布 Hy4 的托管访问；OpenRouter 另行列出了托管提供方。

text.en: Tencent described the new weights and system card as forthcoming; an August Hy4-preview repository does not verify their publication.
text.zhHans: 腾讯称新权重与系统卡将在未来发布；8 月创建的 Hy4-preview 仓库不能证明此次权重已经公开。
